record_title: Positive-density spherical harmonics simultaneously saturating all Sogge Lp branches
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Round spheres S^n with n>=2 only. The construction yields every fixed density rho<1/2, not density 1/2, full density, or a complete eigenbasis; it does not establish an optimal simultaneous-density threshold. Constants may depend on p, n, and rho, and no general-manifold extension is claimed. The source preprint is recent and a folklore or unindexed parallel observation remains possible.
